mgmt_bio.text: Linda Rendle has been chair and chief executive officer of The Clorox Company since September 2020, taking on the chair role in January 2024. She joined Clorox in 2003 in the Sales division, holding roles of increasing responsibility in sales planning and supply chain, and previously worked at Procter and Gamble in sales management. Before becoming CEO she was president of the company from May to September 2020, and earlier served as executive vice president for cleaning, international, strategy and operations, as well as senior vice president and general manager of the cleaning division and vice president and general manager of home care. She holds a bachelor's degree in economics from Harvard University and serves on the boards of Visa Inc. and the Consumer Brands Association.
